chat.text: I want a cute robot that tells my daughter bedtime stories and remembers her favorite characters.

I would love to design this bedtime storyteller for her! I'll plan a small USB-powered robot and use India for parts sourcing; both choices can be changed.

Her age will guide the story length, vocabulary, and the physical shape of the robot. This determines whether the robot needs a microphone for her to speak to it, or if it will be controlled by a parent.

physical_checks.title: Power-on and self-test
physical_checks.expected: On USB-C power the gadget starts, and every module passes its self-test as described in SOFTWARE_SETUP.md: button, display, light, microphone, speaker.

physical_checks.title: Story, stop and volume
physical_checks.expected: A tap plays a story through the speaker; a tap during a story stops it; the volume is comfortable at the listening position.

physical_checks.title: Listening light and confirmation
physical_checks.expected: The microphone opens only while the button is held, the light shows it is listening, and a new favourite is kept only after an explicit confirming tap.

physical_checks.title: Memory after restart
physical_checks.expected: A confirmed favourite is still there after unplugging and re-plugging power, and appears in a later story.

physical_checks.title: Local API
physical_checks.expected: From a phone or computer on the same network, GET /api/state returns the gadget's state and POST /api/action performs an action.

physical_checks.title: Closed-case heat, power and retention
physical_checks.expected: During a 30-minute session with the gadget closed there are no resets, no part becomes uncomfortably warm to touch, nothing rattles and no cable is pinched.

physical_checks.title: Stability
physical_checks.expected: The gadget stands level on its feet and does not tip or slide during normal use by a child under adult supervision.

concepts.title: Sleepy Bear
concepts.blurb: A soft, cuddly bear shape with sleepy animated eyes and a tummy button.

spec.tagline: A gentle bear that tells stories about her favorite friends.

safety.notes: Adult assembly required. Microphone only active when button is held.

behaviour.summary: Tap the top button for a bedtime story. Hold it down and tell the bear your new favorite character; it will remember for next time. The tummy light glows warmly during stories and turns blue when listening.

spec.name: Sleepy Bear

concepts.title: Little Cloud
concepts.blurb: A bumpy, soft cloud shape with a calming night light and flush cheeks.

behaviour.summary: Tap the cloud's top button for a soothing story. Hold it to whisper a new favorite character. The light glows like a sunset while playing and twinkles when listening.

spec.name: Little Cloud

safety.notes: Adult assembly required. Microphone only active when button is held.

spec.tagline: A floating cloud friend full of magical stories.

concepts.title: Bedtime Owl
concepts.blurb: A classic bedside owl with cute ear tufts and large, expressive screen eyes.

safety.notes: Adult assembly required. Microphone only active when button is held.

behaviour.summary: Press the tummy button for a story. Hold it to tell the owl who should be in the next adventure. The chest light glows softly through the night.

spec.name: Bedtime Owl
spec.tagline: A wise little owl that loves bedtime stories.
